Priya: FYI Rita submitted a resignation this morning. Last day is 2026-04-10. Can we coord offboard checklist + exit interview?

Sam: ack. Thanks for flagging. I'll own knowledge transfer for the core services she owns.

Jordan: can we block two 1hr KT sessions next week? Thu/Fri mornings work for me.

Rita: happy to do KT. I can prepare runbooks + short demo. Also, I'll return the company laptop — what next?

Alex (IT Support): @Priya created IT ticket HR-9842 for device pickup + deprovisioning. Steps for team: 1) confirm serial #, 2) create asset return label, 3) schedule pickup. Quick commands for deprovision (admins):
```
# revoke Okta session + SSO
okta-cli deactivate-user rita.chen@redwood.ai
# revoke GCP service account keys
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=rita@redwood.ai
```

Kelsey: benefits note — medical coverage runs through the last day of the month of termination by default. With last day 2026-04-10, active through 2026-04-30. COBRA enrollment window will be emailed by ADP within 14 days after termination. I'll DM Rita the enrollment packet.

Sam: for repo ownership: Rita currently owns infra-monitoring and realtime-ingest. @Jordan can you list 2 engineers to hand these to? Also need to transfer any scheduled pager rotations.

Jordan: suggested owners: Mei for infra-monitoring, Arjun for realtime-ingest. I'll open the ownership PRs and update CODEOWNERS.

Rita: link to my KT doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/rita/oncall-kt — contains runbooks, credentials to rotate, and scheduled jobs. I'll also push a short video walk-through by EOD Tue.

Priya: Action items summary:
- @Alex (IT Support): schedule device pickup + generate UPS label (HR-9842).
- @Kelsey: send COBRA + benefits packet; confirm last-pay details.
- @Jordan: CODEOWNERS PR + pager rotation handoff.
- @Sam: coordinate KT sessions and accept teardown notes.
- @Rita: upload demo and confirm list of external vendor accounts to be deprovisioned.
Please update the HR ticket when each item is done.

peopleops-bot: Exit interview scheduled draft sent to Rita and Sam — propose 2026-04-08 10:00 AM PT. RSVP pending.

Rita: 10am on 4/8 works for me. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Sam: will add to the calendar and invite Mei/Arjun to KT.

Alex (IT Support): small note on external apps: please list any third-party services with shared admin logins. We'll rotate creds + remove invites. Example list format: app | admin user | business owner.

Kelsey: payroll check — final paycheck + accrued PTO will process on the regular cycle; I'll confirm the exact date in the HR ticket.

Priya: great. I'll close the thread once HR-9842 shows all green. :thumbsup:

Sam: thanks team.

(peopleops-bot pinned message: HR-9842 — Offboard | Rita Chen)
